item.title: Home network topology
item.description:
Home network topology

flowchart TD
 %% Internet & Core Gateway
 WAN["WAN (ISP Modem)"] --> PFSENSE["pfSense Router & Firewall"]

 %% Router points to the 3 VLANs
 subgraph VLANS ["VLAN Segmentation & Policies"]
 direction TB
 VLAN_PRIV["<b>Private VLAN</b><br/>Private SSID<br/><i>(Full WAN access • Access to all other VLANs)</i>"]
 VLAN_IOT["<b>IoT / Guest VLAN</b><br/>IOT/Guest SSID<br/><i>(WAN access only • Isolated from other VLANs)</i>"]
 VLAN_TV["<b>TV VLAN</b><br/>TV SSID with no external access<br/><i>(NO external WAN access • Isolated from other VLANs)</i>"]

 %% Inter-VLAN Access Rules
 VLAN_PRIV ==>|"Full Access"| VLAN_IOT
 VLAN_PRIV ==>|"Full Access"| VLAN_TV
 end

 PFSENSE -->|"Routes to"| VLAN_PRIV
 PFSENSE -->|"Routes to"| VLAN_IOT
 PFSENSE -->|"Routes to (Blocks WAN)"| VLAN_TV

 %% Wired Infrastructure: All ports go to Private Network
 subgraph WIRED ["Wired Network"]
 direction TB
 SWITCH["Wired Switch<br/><i>(Tagged Private)</i>"]
 NAS["NAS"]
 HA["Home Assistant"]
 COMPUTERS["Trusted devices"]

 SWITCH --> NAS
 SWITCH --> HA
 SWITCH --> COMPUTERS
 end

 VLAN_PRIV --> SWITCH

 %% Wireless Infrastructure: AP broadcasts 3 SSIDs for all VLANs
 subgraph WIRELESS ["Wireless Network"]
 direction TB
 AP["Wireless Access Point<br/><b>Broadcasts 4 SSIDs tagged:</b><br/>• Private VLAN<br/>• IOT/Guest VLAN<br/>• TV restricted VLAN<br/>• Camera VLAN"]

 AP -.- PHONES
 AP -.- IOT_DEVS
 AP -.- TV
 end

 PFSENSE -->|"802.1Q Trunk (All VLANs)"| AP

 %% Styling
 classDef default fill:#1f232a,stroke:#3b4252,color:#eceff4
 classDef infra fill:#2e3440,stroke:#88c0d0,stroke-width:2px,color:#eceff4
 classDef vlanPriv fill:#243328,stroke:#a3be8c,stroke-width:2px,color:#eceff4
 classDef vlanIot fill:#352c24,stroke:#d08770,stroke-width:2px,color:#eceff4
 classDef vlanTv fill:#332228,stroke:#bf616a,stroke-width:2px,color:#eceff4
 classDef devices fill:#2e3440,stroke:#81a1c1,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#eceff4

 class WAN,PFSENSE infra
 class VLAN_PRIV vlanPriv
 class VLAN_IOT vlanIot
 class VLAN_TV vlanTv
 class SWITCH,AP,NAS,HA,COMPUTERS,PHONES,IOT_DEVS,TV devices

Network Overview & Rules

  • VLANs & Routing: The pfSense router creates separate VLANs:
    • Private VLAN: Unrestricted WAN internet access and full routing access to all other VLANs.
    • IoT / Guest VLAN: Outbound WAN internet access only; blocked from accessing other VLANs.
    • Camera VLAN: No access to internet or any other part of network. Accessible from Private VLAN.
    • TV VLAN: No access to internet or any other part of network.
  • Wired Switch: All wired switch ports connect directly into the Private Network (hosting Synology NAS, Home Assistant, Printer, and Computers).
  • Access Point: Broadcasts distinct SSIDs corresponding to all 4 VLANs and tags packet for correct routing.
  • Wireless Devices: Their data is tagged according to which SSID they joined.
